name: ado-html-report-viewer
description: Private Azure DevOps tab for static HTML build reports.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run size
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path release
scripts.publish: npm run package && tfx extension publish --vsix $(find release -name '*.vsix' -maxdepth 1 -print -quit) --share-with <ORG_NAME>
